title: Lior and the Winter
author: Emrys Dravenmoor
blurb: Marguerite Galloway, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
